name: XLA_ONLINE_ACCTING_REQS
description: This table contains Online Accounting Requests.

columns.name: OAR_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the online accounting request.

columns.name: CLIENT_LANGUAGE
columns.description: Name of the language at client side.

columns.name: APPLICATION_ID
columns.description: Functional area within a software suite of products. For example, Financials or Payroll.

columns.name: ACCOUNTING_MODE
columns.description: Accounting Mode. D: Draft, T: Test, F: Final.

columns.name: LOW_PRIORITY_FLAG
columns.description: Low priority indicator in online accounting processing.

columns.name: TIMEOUT
columns.description: Timeout value for online accounting processing.

columns.name: RETURN_MSG
columns.description: Return message in online accounting processing.

columns.name: CLIENT_TIMEOUT_FLAG
columns.description: Client timeout indicator in online accounting processing.

columns.name: CLIENT_READ_FLAG
columns.description: Client read indicator in online accounting processing.

columns.name: PROC_CRID
columns.description: Identifier of a process request in online accounting processing.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
